title: Analysis of a Distributed Optimization-Based Control Architecture for Inverter-Interfaced Virtual Power Plants
authors: Vivek Khatana, Soham Chakraborty, Murti V. Salapaka
abstract: We develop a large-signal stability analysis for a sampled-data, optimization-based secondary controller for inverter-interfaced distributed energy resources in virtual power plants.
